Patch Set 3:

(2 comments)

Experimental feature testing in progress, please pay attention to the comments

Some concerns, see inline comments. Read decompression is now gated on the client-global llite_enable_compression rather than the per-file cp_compr_type that decompress_request() already checks. That opens a window where toggling the tunable off returns compressed data undecompressed. Understood this is a preview stop-gap, but the data-integrity aspect isn't reflected in the commit message.

commit.subject: LU-10026 osc: don't do decomp. with compression disabled
commit.message:
LU-10026 osc: don't do decomp. with compression disabled

decompress_request likely has a significant performance
cost for checking if data is compressed, so we should not
call it when compression is disabled.

This is a stop-gap solution for the preview until we can
have the server tell the client if data is compressed, as
described in EX-7818.

Test-Parameters: forjanitoronly
Signed-off-by: Patrick Farrell <pfarrell@whamcloud.com>
Signed-off-by: Marc Vef <mvef@whamcloud.com>
Change-Id: Iba8feba3ab0fe620d0594f59c2c6ddea25faeb4f
